ambiguities: The crossover propositions are top-down: a team-level mean predicts an individual-level outcome. The kernel's scope check requires both constructs at the declared level and has no rule which lowers a level, so the proposition as stated at the individual level is expected to be rejected.

errors.message: scope mismatch in `team_burnout_crossover`: TeamBurnout lives at Team / Weekly but the proposition declares Individual / Weekly; no registered rule bridges the gap (needs an Aggregation from TeamBurnout to a Individual-level construct)

overlap_warnings.message:
shares primitive Energy with TeamEngagement.vigor
  TeamBurnout.energy ~ TeamEngagement.vigor : Energy at Team / Weekly
  overlap kind: subtype (every primitive of TeamBurnout is a primitive of TeamEngagement)
  resolve with: declare_overlap TeamBurnout distinct_from TeamEngagement "reason" (or alias_of / subtype_of)
